description: This file defines the AnswerOptions class, which manages answer option data for questionnaires, including saving, retrieving, and validating answer options within a database context.

classes.name: AnswerOptions
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations for answer options associated with questionnaire answers, including validation and retrieval with filtering, pagination, and counting features.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the current answer option object and saves it to the database using a REPLACE query; appends errors if any occur.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of answer options with optional filters, pagination, and counting functionality.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the answer option data; currently always returns true.
